# Proposal: Modular Documentation Architecture & Minimal DaisyUI Showcase Redesign

## Why

The current `README.md` and GitHub Pages showcase (`https://driesverb.github.io/html-report/`) suffer from extreme information overload. `README.md` is an uncurated 370-line dump of ASCII diagrams, massive 17-CDN version tables, and internal harness state machine code blocks. Simultaneously, `index.html` (3,766 lines) acts as a monolithic "visual bomb" that forces visitors to scroll through dozens of disparate charts, maps, calendars, and LaTeX equations all at once.

To establish `html-report` as a top-tier, publication-grade tool for the agent ecosystem, we need a clean, scannable presentation inspired by modern open-source north stars like `daisyui.com`, `tailwindcss.com`, and `shadcn/ui`. We must separate quick onboarding from deep architectural reference by introducing a dedicated `docs/` directory, condensing the root `README.md` into an elegant, scannable guide, and transforming GitHub Pages into an aesthetic, interactive, tabbed showcase landing page with zero visual chaos.

## What Changes

- **Create Dedicated Modular Documentation (`docs/`)**:
  - `docs/getting-started.md`: Installation via 1-click agent prompt, universal symlinks, and CLI.
  - `docs/architecture-fsm.md`: Deep dive on the 10-state deterministic FSM harness, <1ms pre-flight auto-fixes, and small-model remediation directives.
  - `docs/cdn-stack.md`: Complete 17-library catalog, version matrices, SRI hashes, loading guards, and offline bundling.
  - `docs/custom-themes.md`: Custom DaisyUI OKLCH engine, theme inheritance (`extends`), and collapsible studio banner.
  - `docs/live-telemetry.md`: Real-time SSE streaming with Datastar.js, transcript tailing (`agy`, `claude-code`, `codex`), and hypermedia morphing.
  - `docs/testing-and-verification.md`: Zero-framework native BDD harness, Playwright 5-breakpoint verification, and horizontal scrollbar detection.
  - `docs/api-and-cli-reference.md`: Comprehensive CLI flags (`build-report.mjs`, `harness.mjs`, `serve-report.mjs`) and programmatic API usage.

- **Overhaul `README.md` to Minimalist North-Star Standards**:
  - Crisp hero banner with punchy elevator pitch.
  - Minimalist badge strip (only 4 essential badges: License, LLM-Agnostic, 17 CDNs, Tests Passing).
  - Frictionless 1-click agent prompt copy box & 1-line CLI install.
  - Punchy "Why `html-report`?" comparison and concise ASCII pipeline diagram.
  - 2-step Quickstart guide (Write Fragment -> Run Harness -> Done).
  - Clean Documentation Hub index with direct links to all `docs/*.md` guides.
  - Live showcase link with clear call to action.

- **Redesign GitHub Pages Showcase (`index.html`) to DaisyUI North-Star Minimalist Aesthetic**:
  - Replaces the 3,766-line vertical visual dump with a sleek, clean, modern landing page.
  - **Hero Section**: Modern title, subheader, 1-click prompt install card with copy button, and "Get Started" / "Explore Capabilities" buttons.
  - **Value Proposition Grid**: Clean, spacious DaisyUI cards highlighting speed (<100ms), 32 themes, 17 non-blocking CDNs, cryptographic security, and Playwright verification.
  - **Interactive Capability Explorer**: Clean, modern tabbed interface (Data Visualizations, Architecture Flows, Interactive Tables, Live Telemetry, Formatted Math & Code) that lets visitors interactively test each CDN library without visual chaos.
  - **Documentation Hub**: Grid of cards linking directly to the markdown docs in `docs/` with 1-click Showdown modal preview or direct view.
  - **Dedicated Demo Links**: Direct buttons to standalone deep-dive reports and live dashboards.
  - Full adherence to 16/17 CDN parity and zero console errors (`tests/browser-runtime-integrity.test.mjs` verification).

- **Update Feature Companion & Dev Server**:
  - Create companion `openspec/changes/docs-and-showcase-redesign/index.html` with Journey Stepper, live task progress, and Showdown backlinks.
  - Sync with `implementation-progress.html` on `http://localhost:3000`.

## Capabilities

### New Capabilities
- `modular-documentation-and-showcase`: Modular root-level `docs/` architecture, minimalist standard `README.md`, and aesthetic DaisyUI tabbed landing page showcase at repo root (`index.html`).

### Modified Capabilities
- None.

## Impact

- `README.md`: Drastically shortened, scannable, and modern.
- `docs/`: 7 new structured deep-dive markdown guides.
- `index.html`: Complete redesign to a clean landing page with tabbed capability explorer.
- Tests: `tests/browser-runtime-integrity.test.mjs` continues to pass with 0 console errors and full CDN global verification.

# Design: Modular Documentation Architecture & Minimal DaisyUI Showcase Redesign

## Context

See [proposal.md](proposal.md) for the motivation. Currently, `README.md` attempts to be an installation guide, architecture specification, benchmark dashboard, and API manual simultaneously. At the same time, `index.html` (hosted on GitHub Pages) renders thousands of lines of stacked charts, diagrams, tables, and formula blocks sequentially, overwhelming first-time visitors.

This design introduces a modular documentation architecture in `docs/`, condenses `README.md` into an open-source standard landing document, and redesigns `index.html` into a DaisyUI-powered interactive landing page with a tabbed capability explorer.

## Goals / Non-Goals

**Goals:**
- Create a dedicated, well-structured `docs/` directory containing 7 modular guides for onboarding, FSM architecture, CDN catalog, custom themes, real-time telemetry, verification, and CLI reference.
- Restructure `README.md` into a scannable, modern document adhering to open-source best practices (daisyUI, Astro, Shadcn).
- Redesign `index.html` into an aesthetic, minimalist landing page featuring a hero banner, 1-click install card, key value proposition cards, an interactive tabbed capability explorer, and a documentation hub with Showdown modal viewer integration.
- Preserve 100% test compatibility: `tests/browser-runtime-integrity.test.mjs` must load `index.html` with zero console/page errors and verify all 16 CDN globals.

**Non-Goals:**
- Altering the underlying CLI tools (`build-report.mjs`, `harness.mjs`, `serve-report.mjs`) or core runtime behavior.
- Replacing the 17-library CDN stack or dropping any supported capability.

## Decisions

### 1. Dedicated `docs/` Directory Structure
- **Decision**: Move in-depth technical details from `README.md` into dedicated markdown files in `docs/`:
  - `docs/getting-started.md`
  - `docs/architecture-fsm.md`
  - `docs/cdn-stack.md`
  - `docs/custom-themes.md`
  - `docs/live-telemetry.md`
  - `docs/testing-and-verification.md`
  - `docs/api-and-cli-reference.md`
- **Rationale**: Keeps `README.md` under 150 lines, focused on value proposition, quick install, and rapid onboarding. Developers and agents can navigate directly to specific topic guides as needed.

### 2. Tabbed Interactive Capability Explorer for GitHub Pages (`index.html`)
- **Decision**: Replace the vertical 3,800-line stack with a modern DaisyUI tabbed component explorer:
  - Tab 1: **Data & Visualizations** (Chart.js multi-dataset canvas with theme sync)
  - Tab 2: **Architecture & Flows** (Mermaid sequence and flow diagrams)
  - Tab 3: **Interactive Tables** (Grid.js sortable, searchable table)
  - Tab 4: **Live LLM Telemetry** (Datastar streaming simulation drawer)
  - Tab 5: **Rich Math & Code** (KaTeX LaTeX equations + Highlight.js code formatting)
- **Rationale**: Gives visitors immediate, interactive proof of all capabilities in a compact, viewport-friendly layout without "visual bomb" cognitive overload.

### 3. Integrated Showdown Markdown Viewer for Documentation Cards
- **Decision**: In `index.html`, render a Documentation Hub grid where each card links to a `docs/*.md` file. Clicking a card opens the document in the built-in Showdown markdown modal viewer (`window.openMarkdownViewer('docs/...')`) with tabbed source preview and print capability.
- **Rationale**: Allows visitors on GitHub Pages to read comprehensive documentation without navigating away or dealing with raw GitHub markdown rendering.

### 4. Preservation of 16-CDN Global Parity & Browser Runtime Integrity
- **Decision**: Keep all 16 CDN library imports and sample initializers in `index.html`, mounting them inside the interactive tab panels.
- **Rationale**: Ensures `tests/browser-runtime-integrity.test.mjs` passes identically while demonstrating that all 17 libraries co-exist cleanly without conflicts.

## Risks / Trade-offs

- **[Risk] Lazy initialization in tabs could cause hidden canvas or map rendering sizing bugs.**  
  → *Mitigation*: Ensure Chart.js and Leaflet invalidate/resize upon tab switch using Alpine.js or native tab change listeners (`chart.resize()`, `map.invalidateSize()`).
- **[Risk] Broken relative links between `README.md`, `docs/`, and GitHub Pages.**  
  → *Mitigation*: Use standard relative paths (`docs/getting-started.md`) that work seamlessly on both GitHub's web interface and local clones.

specs/modular-documentation-and-showcase:
# Spec Delta: modular-documentation-and-showcase

## Purpose

Establishes a modular documentation architecture in the `docs/` directory, an ultra-scannable minimalist README following open-source north-star standards, and an aesthetic, tabbed DaisyUI landing page showcase for GitHub Pages (`index.html`) that replaces monolithic content dumping with interactive progressive disclosure.

## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: Modular Root Documentation Directory
The repository SHALL maintain a dedicated `docs/` directory containing focused, topic-specific markdown guides for onboarding, architecture, styling, and verification.

#### Scenario: Inspecting modular docs directory
- **WHEN** a developer or agent inspects the `docs/` directory
- **THEN** guides for `getting-started.md`, `architecture-fsm.md`, `cdn-stack.md`, `custom-themes.md`, `live-telemetry.md`, `testing-and-verification.md`, and `api-and-cli-reference.md` SHALL be present and linked

### Requirement: Minimal Scannable Standard README
The root `README.md` SHALL present an elevator pitch, minimal essential badges, 1-click agent prompt and CLI installation instructions, a 2-step quickstart example, and a clean documentation index linking to `docs/`.

#### Scenario: Inspecting root README layout and documentation links
- **WHEN** a user reads `README.md`
- **THEN** it provides copyable install commands, links to live demo and `docs/`, and avoids embedding full state machine code or exhaustive CDN version tables

### Requirement: Minimalist Aesthetic Landing Page Showcase
The GitHub Pages entrypoint (`index.html`) SHALL provide a DaisyUI-powered minimal landing page featuring a hero section, value proposition cards, an interactive tabbed capability explorer, and a documentation hub linking to all guides.

#### Scenario: Loading GitHub Pages index.html showcase
- **WHEN** a visitor loads `index.html` in a web browser
- **THEN** the page renders with zero console errors, displays hero and capability cards, and provides full 16-CDN runtime integrity

#### Scenario: Switching capability explorer tabs
- **WHEN** a visitor clicks capability tabs (such as Data & Visualizations, Architecture Flows, Interactive Tables, Live Telemetry, or Formatted Math & Code)
- **THEN** the active tab displays the selected interactive component preview without requiring full-page scrolling

#### Scenario: Previewing documentation via Showdown viewer
- **WHEN** a visitor clicks any documentation link in the landing page documentation hub
- **THEN** the runtime activates the interactive Showdown markdown modal to display the formatted guide directly in the browser
